description: Create an empty folder in the workspace tree, to group scene objects. A folder holds no asset: it is a named transform, so moving or rotating it moves everything attached under it (use studio_attach_object to put objects in it). Optionally names and places it; otherwise Studio's default name and spawn position are used. Studio has no undo command for adding a folder, so this **clears the undo stack**, as the workspace button itself does. Returns the created folder, including its id.

name.description: name of the folder; omitted, Studio's default is used

output.description: same shape as one entry of studio_list_objects
